The scenario should occur on the Town01 map with a similar mission type and no additional dynamic actors.

vehicle_cmd must remain zero or near-zero while vehicle_status indicates nonzero ego velocity in the critical window
scenario must run on Town01 with no additional non-ego actors spawned
uncertainty: Dataset.xlsx reports lane_invasion=1 while error.json reports lane_invasion=false, so lane invasion is not confirmed.
